test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45834f55d092c091af2ec4f4b029323fe5752fe691acd1ce486cc91b2b4da38b.png] 

Logic followed here is:

The difference between the positional values of consecutive letters in each cluster follows a specific pattern (e.g., +6, +4, +4), except for the odd cluster.

1) SYDG:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/919fcdcd9a4f412b1cb3e295ee5a428adaddefba1ccaa56e3e0800e243c1abf2.png] 

2) UAEI:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3db1f79ba19ece1d635109bbb30dc6915576769adbc111c51d9dc43b49b3bc16.png] 

3) HNRV:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0b91db1b3af0cfccf80affd1ea84001f8bdbb9bd2829b2d0f010f15ca93f9c2.png] 

4) XDHL:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/976cb1ad0700fbbe3a4c4df35947f35a1624c724df5bb50ce090d8eaff01b2a9.png] 

 

Therefore, the letter-cluster 'SYDG' is the odd one out as it does not follow the +6, +4, +4 pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
